name: codebase-memory
description: Keep codebase-memory indexed at session start, then query its code graph from a shell.

interface.shortDescription: Shell queries over the codebase-memory code graph.
interface.longDescription: Starts a detached fast index for the current Git main checkout at Claude Code and Codex session start. Runs codebase-memory-mcp cli against that indexed repository with no MCP server involved, so a shell script or an agent without the MCP tools can still ask structural questions: who calls a function, how a change propagates, which modules cluster together, which functions have no callers, and what a symbol's source says.
defaultPrompt: What breaks if I change this symbol?
